title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots
tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

faults.what: Both supplied screenshots have been visibly regenerated rather than preserved faithfully: the phone-screen labels and values are distorted, garbled, and difficult to read, especially on the workout screen.

judge.summary: The ad has clean widescreen styling, the correct screen order, and a clear FitTrack ending, but corrupted screenshot text requires a redo.

must_haves.item: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The reported duration is 10.1 seconds, effectively the requested 10 seconds, and the displayed frames are landscape 16:9.

must_haves.item: The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
must_haves.why: The home-screen layout appears at 1.3 seconds, followed by the workout-screen layout at 3.8 and 6.3 seconds.

must_haves.item: Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
must_haves.why: Their broad layouts and colors remain recognizable, but the UI text has been visibly altered into distorted lettering rather than retained as readable screenshot content.
The ending frame prominently displays the correctly spelled app name.

must_haves.item: An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The sound report indicates audio and no clear speech, consistent with no voiceover, but does not establish an upbeat instrumental beat.
